title: Subcubic $K_4$-minor-free graphs without crumby colorings
summary: Motivated by Wegner's conjecture on squares of planar graphs, Thomassen conjectured that every 3-connected cubic graph on at least eight vertices admits a red-blue vertex coloring in which the blue subgraph has maximum degree at most 1, while the red subgraph has minimum degree at least 1 and contains no $P_4$. Such colorings are now called crumby colorings.
